town.title: Town Council
town.difficulty: everyday to hard tasks on small accounts
town.planningMode: CLOOP town. One flow, kept by cloop.mjs. At each state entry: `node cloop.mjs status` → step card (intent, route, objection) → act → record through the tool → `advance`. Never edit cloop/state.json, log.jsonl or board.md by hand; a refusal means meet the guard or step back. Remove before adding, whole before detail, goal before measure. The small loop builds and corrects. Every one-shot, loop and explore opens with PREVENT. Every step back looks at the whole before the detail: all the evidence, the class and root cause, removal first, the real property, one correction for the whole property. The tool computes each outcome and the rung: small (your step back) → full (two loop-breakers) → re-define (the user approves a re-plan); PASS returns to small, ADVANCED de-escalates from full and re-define. BEST moves only forward. Real runs judge: never shorten a run, a wait or a judging step. Judges are read-only reviewers returning one line per criterion; loop-breakers write in their own worktrees; builders, when listed, take only build steps; reproduce every NOT_MET yourself. The user is in the loop: ask their decisions with a recommendation and keep working on the rest. Send `node cloop.mjs report` after every judging and `report --final` first at ACCEPT. After any compaction, reread this file and run `status`.
